authority.item_callback_abi: ASN1_AUX.asn1_cb is an informational callback called by the ASN.1 item machinery around each operation. On NEW_POST/D2I_POST/FREE_PRE/FREE_POST `*pval` is the live value slot for the declared item type; NEW_PRE and CHOICE D2I_PRE may be called before allocation, so `*pval` may be NULL there. For a non-primitive item the free walk returns before any callback when the stored value is NULL (tasn_fre.c's item-embed-free guard), so FREE_PRE/FREE_POST only see NULL for primitive items whose value lives in the slot. The streaming operations receive the caller-supplied value and the ASN1_STREAM_ARG.

precondition_set: At ASN1_OP_FREE_POST, `*pval` is a live `CmsEncryptedContentInfo` owned by the free walk; `key` is NULL or this object's own CRYPTO_* block of `keylen` bytes, released exactly once.
boundaries.disposition: SAFETY_DISCHARGED: src/cms/cms_asn1.rs:523 — cms_ec_cb dereferences `*pval` only inside the `ASN1_OP_FREE_POST` arm. The item free walk returns before invoking any callback when a non-primitive item's stored value is NULL, and the item is an NDEF_SEQUENCE, so FREE_POST always receives a live object. The template walk has already released the ASN.1 fields (`content_type`, `content_encryption_algorithm`, `encrypted_content`); `key`/`keylen` are runtime members it does not touch, so the callback is their single release.
boundaries.contract: C ABI `int (int, ASN1_VALUE **, const ASN1_ITEM *, void *)`. The callback acts only on ASN1_OP_FREE_POST, where `*pval` is a live `CMS_EncryptedContentInfo`. `key` is NULL or the object's own single CRYPTO_* allocation of `keylen` bytes, and is released exactly once with `OPENSSL_clear_free(key, keylen)`. No other operation has a precondition: every other operation returns 1 without reading `*pval`.
established: `item_embed_free` evaluates `let value = *pval; if item.itype != ASN1_ITYPE_PRIMITIVE && value.is_null() { return; }` before the SEQUENCE/CHOICE arms (src/asn1/fre.rs:217-221), so a NULL slot never reaches FREE_PRE/FREE_POST for a non-primitive item.
`ASN1_item_free`/`ASN1_item_ex_free` are the only free entries (src/asn1/fre.rs:430-448); both pass a live slot to `item_embed_free`.
The item is `ASN1_ITYPE_NDEF_SEQUENCE` (src/cms/cms_asn1.rs:1322-1330), so the guard applies and the FREE_POST call at src/asn1/fre.rs:345-348 has a non-NULL `*pval`.

`CmsEncryptedContentInfo.key`/`keylen` are not template fields (the three templates are content_type, content_encryption_algorithm, encrypted_content); the generic walk cannot release them, so the callback owns their single release.
Every other operation returns 1 without forming a reference: the arm test is `operation == ASN1_OP_FREE_POST`, so NEW_PRE (where `*pval` may be NULL) and all D2I/I2D/PRINT/DUP operations are inert.

NEW_POST follows the allocation in `item_embed_new` (or follows the caller-provided embedded storage), so the slot is non-NULL and the block is zeroed before the callback; FREE_POST is guarded by `item_embed_free`'s non-primitive NULL check. boundaries.contract: C ABI `int (int, ASN1_VALUE **, const ASN1_ITEM *, void *)`. At ASN1_OP_NEW_POST `*pval` is the freshly allocated and zero-initialised `CMS_KeyAgreeRecipientInfo`, so its `ctx`/`pctx` slots are writable; the callback installs a new cipher context or fails. At ASN1_OP_FREE_POST `*pval` is the live object and `ctx`/`pctx` are NULL or contexts it owns, released exactly once. All other operations return 1 after at most casting the slot contents (never dereferencing a NULL value).
established: `item_embed_new` calls ASN1_OP_NEW_PRE before allocating (slot may be NULL) and ASN1_OP_NEW_POST after the block is allocated/zeroed (src/asn1/new.rs:264-352); the callback only acts on NEW_POST.

A zeroed `CmsKeyAgreeRecipientInfo` is a valid value for this callback: every field is a raw pointer, integer or pointer to `CmsCtx`; the callback writes only `ctx` and `pctx`.

`EVP_CIPHER_CTX_new` failure returns 0, and the item machinery then frees the partially initialised value through `item_embed_free`; FREE_POST sees `ctx == NULL`/`pctx == NULL`, and both `EVP_CIPHER_CTX_free`/`EVP_PKEY_CTX_free` accept NULL.
D2I_PRE for a SEQUENCE is invoked after allocation (src/asn1/d2i.rs:1922-1939) and D2I_POST after a successful decode (src/asn1/d2i.rs:2088-2095); both are inert arms here.

boundaries.signature: unsafe extern "C" fn cms_ri_cb(operation: c_int, pval: *mut *mut c_void, _it: *const Asn1Item, _exarg: *mut c_void) -> c_int
precondition_set: `*pval` is a live `CMS_RecipientInfo` whenever the callback runs; when `type_` is TRANS/KEK/PASS, `d` points at the corresponding live arm.
boundaries.disposition: SAFETY_DISCHARGED: src/cms/cms_asn1.rs:617 — Every dereference (FREE_PRE, D2I_POST, NEW_POST) is on a non-NULL value: the free guard excludes NULL for a CHOICE, and both decode/create paths allocate before the POST callback. The FREE_PRE switch reads `type_`; the invariant 'type_ is an arm index implies d is live' is established by the constructors (which store `d` before setting `type_`) and by D2I_POST (`type_ = encoded_type`, the selector of the alternative just decoded). NEW_POST stores the selector value -1, so a fresh value takes the `_ => {}` arm rather than an arm dereference.
boundaries.contract: C ABI `int (int, ASN1_VALUE **, const ASN1_ITEM *, void *)`. The value slot is live whenever the callback runs: CHOICE FREE_PRE/FREE_POST are guarded by `item_embed_free`; CHOICE D2I_POST runs only after an alternative matched and the selector was stored; CHOICE NEW_POST runs after the fresh block was allocated and the selector set to -1. When `type_` names an arm (TRANS/KEK/PASS), `d` points at that arm's live object. `encoded_type` is the CHOICE selector at offset 0.
established: `item_embed_free` returns for a NULL non-primitive value before the CHOICE arm (src/asn1/fre.rs:217-221); the item is `ASN1_ITYPE_CHOICE` with `utype: 0` (selector at offset 0) (src/cms/cms_asn1.rs:1991-1999).

`item_embed_new` allocates or zeroes the CHOICE block, calls `set_choice_selector(pval, -1)`, then NEW_POST (src/asn1/new.rs:214-261). NEW_POST therefore stores `type_ = -1` (`CMS_RECIPINFO_NONE`), not an arm index (src/cms/cms_asn1.rs:658-661; constants at :74-80).

`embed_d2i` CHOICE calls D2I_POST only after `template_ex_d2i` matched an alternative and `set_choice_selector` stored its index (src/asn1/d2i.rs:1822-1854); the arm pointer `d` was installed by that decode.

Every in-crate constructor stores `d` before setting `type_`: `cms_RecipientInfo_ktri_init` (:775 then :781-782), `ossl_cms_RecipientInfo_kari_init` (:832 then :838-839), `CMS_add0_recipient_key` (cms_env.rs:1917-1920), `CMS_add0_recipient_password` (cms_pwri.rs:397 then :411-412), `ossl_cms_RecipientInfo_kemri_init` (cms_kemri.rs:191-194 with the ORI installed first).

`CMS_RecipientInfo` is a private item (`cms_recipientinfo_it` is pub(crate) and not exported); the only re-decode path into an existing CHOICE element is the generic `embed_d2i` existing-value branch, which `SEQUENCE OF`/`SET OF` element decoding never reaches because each element is decoded into a fresh local slot (src/asn1/d2i.rs:2448-2463). No safe CMS API re-decodes into an existing `CMS_RecipientInfo`.
D2I_POST reads `(*ori).ori_type` only when `type_ == CMS_RECIPINFO_OTHER`; that alternative was just decoded, so `d` is the live ORI (src/cms/cms_asn1.rs:646-657).
tests: courts/phase25/rt_cms_asn1_callbacks.c: d2i of a KARI recipient yields `CMS_RecipientInfo_type == CMS_RECIPINFO_AGREE (1)`, and d2i of a KEM ORI yields `CMS_RECIPINFO_KEM (5)`; a zeroed block would read 0, so the D2I_POST arm provably ran. Freeing TRANS, AGREE and KEM recipients drives FREE_PRE for the three arms plus the `_` arm. Plain PASS; LeakSanitizer PASS.

boundaries.signature: unsafe extern "C" fn cms_cb(operation: c_int, pval: *mut *mut c_void, _it: *const Asn1Item, exarg: *mut c_void) -> c_int
precondition_set: At FREE_POST `*pval` is live. For STREAM/DETACHED, the caller of `BIO_new_NDEF`/`asn1_output_data` passes a live `CMS_ContentInfo` and a live `ASN1_STREAM_ARG`; a NULL value is outside the C ABI contract.
boundaries.disposition: SAFETY_DISCHARGED: src/cms/cms_asn1.rs:668 — The FREE_POST dereference is guarded by the free walk's non-primitive NULL check (the item is an NDEF_SEQUENCE). The streaming arms are not reached from the generic free path: they are invoked by the stream/detach machinery with a caller-supplied live value and a live argument block. The body's own `pval.is_null()` test guards the slot address, which the machinery always provides; the value itself is non-NULL by the caller contract.
boundaries.contract: C ABI `int (int, ASN1_VALUE **, const ASN1_ITEM *, void *)`. On ASN1_OP_FREE_POST `*pval` is a live `CMS_ContentInfo`. On STREAM_PRE/STREAM_POST/DETACHED_PRE/DETACHED_POST the item machinery is entered from `BIO_new_NDEF`/`asn1_output_data`, whose contract requires the value slot to hold a live `CMS_ContentInfo` and `exarg` to be the live `ASN1_STREAM_ARG`; the body dereferences both. All other operations return 1 without dereferencing `*pval`.
established: `item_embed_free` returns for a NULL non-primitive value before the callback (src/asn1/fre.rs:217-221); the item is `ASN1_ITYPE_NDEF_SEQUENCE` (src/cms/cms_asn1.rs:2480-2488).

STREAM_PRE/POST are invoked by `BIO_new_NDEF` with `val` from its caller and a local `sarg` (src/asn1/bio_asn1.rs:903-911); STREAM_POST reuses the stored value in the support block (src/asn1/bio_asn1.rs:1114-1127).
DETACHED_PRE/POST are invoked by `asn1_output_data` with its `val` parameter and a local `sarg` (src/asn1/asn_mime.rs:992-1028).

`BIO_new_NDEF` documents `val` as 'a live value of it's type' (src/asn1/bio_asn1.rs:802-805); `asn1_output_data` documents 'val and it as the encoder requires' (src/asn1/asn_mime.rs:961-963). A NULL value is C-invalid for both, exactly as in the authority.

The I2D_PRE/I2D_POST callbacks, which the encoder also issues, return 1 here without touching `*pval`/`exarg`; `item_ex_i2d` additionally returns before them when a non-primitive value is NULL (src/asn1/i2d.rs:228-237).
FREE_POST releases only `ctx.propq`, a member buffer owned by the object; the template walk does not release it.

The DETACHED arms are NOT_RUN (see not_run). Plain PASS; LeakSanitizer PASS for the non-streaming paths.

instrument_gaps.detail: consumer_closure.py accepts a scoped discharge on (file, kind, operation) identity plus the recorded span hash and the `^SAFETY_DISCHARGED\b` disposition prefix. It does not re-audit the callback bodies, the per-site contracts or the probe; those are reviewer-established.

The admitted install leaks in `BN_generate_prime_ex` under LeakSanitizer: a minimal RSA-keygen program leaks 71080 bytes / 3554 allocations attributed to `BN_value_one`, scaling with the number of prime candidates. This is pre-existing candidate/library behaviour outside the seven callback boundaries (no keygen code is in any B71 span). The probe run suppresses only `leak:BN_value_one`; any release omitted by a callback would still surface as an unsuppressed CRYPTO_* leak.

The STREAM arm exposes a separate 387-byte leak in `bio_asn1::ndef_prefix` (its DER buffer is overwritten by `ndef_suffix`'s buffer assignment). This is in the ASN.1 BIO machinery, not in any B71 callback, and is not repaired here (src/ is out of scope). It is why the LSan run sets RT_B71_SKIP_STREAM=1; the plain run still exercises STREAM_PRE/STREAM_POST.

residuals.detail: The seven callbacks are private local symbols; the probe cannot name them and observes them through the machinery's effects (recipient type, allocated ctx) and LeakSanitizer. Direct per-callback counters are not expressible without editing src/ or instrumenting the DSO.

cms_ri_cb FREE_PRE relies on `type_` being an arm index only when `d` is live. This is established for decoded values (D2I_POST copies the matched selector) and fresh values (NEW_POST copies the -1 selector), and every constructor stores `d` before `type_`. A hypothetical caller that re-decoded into an existing CMS_RecipientInfo could leave a stale `type_`; no such caller exists in the crate (the item is private and `SEQUENCE OF` elements decode into fresh slots).

cms_cb STREAM/DETACHED dereferences the caller-supplied value. `BIO_new_NDEF`/`asn1_output_data` require a live value; a C-invalid NULL value faults there, authority-identical. This is a caller precondition of the C ABI, not a hidden obligation of the callback.

The cms_cb DETACHED_PRE/DETACHED_POST arms were not executed: SMIME_write_CMS(SMIME_DETACHED) refused both an EnvelopedData and a partial SignedData built for the probe. The arms share CMS_dataInit/CMS_dataFinal with the exercised STREAM arms and are discharged at contract level; runtime coverage is NOT_RUN.

A clean LeakSanitizer verdict is reported only after suppressing the candidate's pre-existing `BN_value_one` prime-generation leak (B71-G2) and excluding the unrelated `bio_asn1::ndef_prefix` leak (B71-G3). The suppressed population is recorded; no cleanup performed by any B71 callback is suppressed.
